name: intex
description: ∫TeX is a modern, local-first LaTeX extension for VS Code, offering fast builds, integrated PDF preview, SyncTeX, and smart tooling powered by texlab LSP server.

commands.title: Clean
commands.description: Clean auxiliary files from the active LaTeX document

commands.title: Open PDF
commands.description: Open the PDF viewer for the built document

commands.title: SyncTeX Forward Search
commands.description: Jump from the current editor position to the corresponding location in the PDF viewer

commands.title: Insert Equation
commands.description: Insert a new equation block and open the visual equation editor

commands.title: Edit Equation
commands.description: Open the visual equation editor for an existing equation

commands.title: Insert Table
commands.description: Insert a new table and open the visual table editor

commands.title: Edit Table
commands.description: Open the visual table editor for an existing table

commands.title: Insert Figure
commands.description: Insert a new figure and open the visual figure editor

commands.title: Edit Figure
commands.description: Open the visual figure editor for an existing figure

commands.title: Open BibTeX Editor
commands.description: Open the visual editor for managing BibTeX entries

commands.title: Format Document
commands.description: Format the active LaTeX or BibTeX document using the configured formatter via texlab

intex.buildMethod.description: Build method to use: 'auto' detects available system, 'local' uses local TeX Live, 'docker' uses containerized build

intex.docker.image.description: Docker image to use for containerized builds

intex.docker.userShift.description: Enable user ID shifting for Docker builds on Linux to avoid root-owned output files by adding --user flag for your current user (only has effect if 'intex.buildMethod' is set to 'docker'). It may cause permission issues with mounted volumes on some setups, so you can disable it if you encounter problems (e.g., 'Permission denied' errors for output files).

intex.docker.enableCache.description: Cache LaTeX packages in a Docker volume for faster builds

intex.buildOnSave.description: Automatically build LaTeX documents on save

intex.buildEngine.description: LaTeX engine to use for compilation

intex.latexmk.options.description: Additional options to pass to latexmk

intex.outputDirectory.description: Directory for build output (can be an absolute path or relative to workspace root)

intex.rootFile.description: Main LaTeX file for multi-file projects (e.g., 'main.tex'). When set, builds and SyncTeX always target this file instead of the active editor document. Leave empty for single-file projects.

intex.showOutputChannel.description: When to show the build output channel

intex.bibtexEditor.autoOpen.description: Automatically open the visual BibTeX editor beside the source when a .bib file is opened

intex.lsp.enabled.description: Enable LaTeX language server (texlab) for auto-completion and navigation

enumDescriptions: Use tex-fmt (must be installed and available in PATH)
intex.formatting.latexFormatter.description: Formatter to use for LaTeX documents via texlab. Set 'editor.defaultFormatter' to 'PolarHuskyDev.intex' and 'editor.formatOnSave' to true in your [latex] language settings to enable format-on-save.

enumDescriptions: Use tex-fmt (must be installed and available in PATH)
intex.formatting.bibtexFormatter.description: Formatter to use for BibTeX documents via texlab.

intex.formatting.lineLength.description: Maximum line length for the formatter. Set to -1 for no limit.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
